Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday — really helpful to understand the three pilot goals you listed (CDR extraction, triage summarization, and a low-latency patient Q&A). Per our alignment, the next things that will help us size work and internal approvals: 

- A one-page org map showing owners for Clinical Ops, Engineering (API/platform), Security/Privacy, and Procurement (I can accept a quick screenshot or PDF).
- Any non-negotiable compliance gates for pilot (e.g., local hosting, SOC2 + HIPAA attestation, encryption requirements).
- Who the economic buyer is (name/title) and the preferred procurement process (PO vs. contract signature).

If you can share the org chart and the security contact list we can draft the mutual action plan and a proposed timeline (2–4 weeks for pilot kickoff once legal approves).

Proposed next step: short alignment call next week (30 mins) that includes your Head of Eng and whoever owns procurement. Are you available Wed 31 Jul or Thu 1 Aug?

Attaching our one-pager on pilot scope to make internal routing easier.

Thanks,
Hannah

Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah,

Great write-up and thanks for the summary. Quick answers:

- I've attached the org chart (clinical + eng + security) and a spreadsheet with security/compliance contacts.
- Economic buyer is Dr. Suresh Nair (VP Clinical Innovation) — I copied Ravi (we own the tech eval) but please include procurement for contract routing.
- For the pilot we require: encrypted-at-rest (customer-managed keys preferred), SOC2 Type II evidence, and a short DPIA summary (we can provide our template).

Ravi and procurement team — can you confirm the PO vs. signature route? Our default is PO for <$50k pilots but legal may request signatures depending on data access scope.

I can do Wed 31 Jul 11:00–11:30 PT. CCing Ravi for availability and procurement.

Thanks,
